instruction: Create Polygroups from UV Tiles (UDIMs) The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named UVQuadPlane, is a flat 4x4 subdivided plane in the XY plane centred at origin (side length 2 BU, 16 quad faces, 25 vertices). For this task, open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. The plane's UVs are already laid out across four UDIM tiles: the four 2x2 face-quadrants of the plane each map bijectively to a distinct UDIM. Top-left is tile 1001, top-right is 1002, bottom-left is 1003, and bottom-right is 1004. All 16 faces currently share a single default polygroup. The mesh has no polypaint and no subdivision-level stack. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush with UVs preserved, convert the UV-tile assignments into polygroups, and export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` with both polygroups and UVs preserved. The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly one SubTool, still named UVQuadPlane, with its base geometry unchanged. - Every face has UV indices written out in the OBJ. - The number of distinct polygroup IDs on the mesh is exactly 4. - Each face's UV centroid falls inside exactly one UDIM tile from {1001, 1002, 1003, 1004}, and all four tiles are represented. - Each polygroup's faces all share the same UDIM tile. - The four polygroups collectively use four distinct tiles.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
